archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (adapted for Corporate Luxury)
design_philosophy: Authoritative, modern, and clean. Emphasize clarity and trust through a disciplined 'navy and grey' palette. Avoid generic 'fintech-bro' aesthetics. Use bold sans-serifs for headings and generous, dramatic spacing. Contrast stark grey backgrounds with rich, deep navy blue accents.

layout_and_spacing.grid_tetris: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 md:gap-12
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense text and paragraphs. Use strict grid structures for services. Use optical alignment for icons.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-50/80 border-b border-slate-200/50 sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons_primary: bg-[#1E3A8A] text-white hover:bg-[#1E40AF] px-6 py-3 rounded-sm font-medium transition-colors
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons_secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1E3A8A] text-[#1E3A8A] hover:bg-slate-50 px-6 py-3 rounded-sm font-medium transition-colors

pages.name: Home
sections: Hero: Deep navy background image overlay with bold white typography offering premier investment consulting.
Marquee/Stats: An editorial ribbon showing assets managed or key financial metrics in pale grey.
Services Summary: Bento grid of key services.
About Snippet: High contrast image vs text block showcasing the firm's legacy.
CTA: Massive typography block driving to Book Consultation.

pages.name: Services
sections: Header: Generous spacing, stating the firm's specific consulting areas.
Grid: Investment Consulting, Wealth Management, Business Strategy, Risk Assessment. Each card strictly aligned.

pages.name: About
sections: Story: Tetris layout. Asymmetric grid with a tall image of the team/office and a wide text block.
Values: Swiss brutalist approach. Huge numbers (01, 02) followed by brief, sharp value statements.

pages.name: Contact
sections: Grid Layout: Left side showing contact details (Email, City/Zip). Right side featuring Shadcn Form for inquiries.

pages.name: Book Consultation
sections: Focus page: Minimal distractions, heavy focus on the consultation booking form.
Form: Shadcn UI components (Select for service type, Input, Textarea, Datepicker).

components.navigation: Include brand name 'C&P Global Investors' (and logo), links to Home, Services, About, Contact, and a primary CTA 'Book Consultation'. Use Lucide-react for mobile menu icon.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Textarea, Select, and Button. Render forms with clear, large labels. Form fields must have crisp 1px borders.
components.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with Duotone weight for a premium, high-end look.

media.logo_description: Use as a small geometric avatar or brand mark next to 'C&P Global Investors'.
media.hero_bg_description: Elegant dark blue silky abstract texture. Overlaid with bg-slate-900/60 for text contrast.
media.about_image_description: Contemporary glass building facade reflecting the sky. High-end corporate architecture.
media.services_description: Professionals discussing business strategy in a modern office.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. White text over navy, navy text over slate-50.
accessibility_and_testing.interactive: All buttons, links, and forms must have distinct hover, active, and focus states (e.g. ring-2 ring-[#1E3A8A]).
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: Apply data-testid to ALL interactive and key elements. Format: kebab-case, role-based. e.g. data-testid='nav-book-consultation-button'

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'Cabinet Grotesk' + 'IBM Plex Sans' font pairing. Install via Fontsource or Google Fonts.
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for all icons.
For the Contact details, STRICTLY use only 'Fresno, CA 93722' and 'info@cpglobalinvestors.capital' as requested. DO NOT use the full street address.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for complex layout sections (like Tetris or Bento grids). Rely on Shadcn UI ONLY for interactive components (Forms, Accordions).
Ensure generous spacing: Use py-24 and py-32 for section paddings. Do not cram elements together.
